slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
disgustingly magnetic

laughing easily

laugh freely at other people's jokes, even small ones. people are naturally drawn to whoever makes them feel funny, interesting and like genuinely good company.

asking follow ups

ask one follow up question about whatever someone just told you. most people move on to their own story, so staying curious makes you instantly and lastingly memorable.

slowing your movements

move a little slower than you normally would: walking, turning, reaching for things. calm, unhurried movement reads as quiet confidence from across a room.

always having a story

spend 5 minutes a day learning one surprising story from history or science. people gather around whoever always has something new and interesting to share.
slides.texte_sophia:
always having a story

i used to have nothing to add in conversations. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a surprising story from history or science. people gather around stories.

slides.texte_overlay:
remembering small things

remember the little things people mention: their dog's name, their exam, their trip. being remembered is rare enough to make anyone feel special around you.
